propositions: A reconverge union merge fails with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' when tracked store artifacts have working-tree deletions (staged or unstaged) or modifications, leaving the merge unresolved and local commits orphaned.

The recovery extends the existing _recover_merge_abort seam by parsing the named paths from the abort message, then per porcelain status: restoring tracked deletions from HEAD via git checkout, and copying tracked modifications into reconverge-quarantine before restore.

After recovery actions, the merge is retried once; on success both parents are kept and local commits remain reachable; on any other failure the abort-keep-local-hint-fsck-recover behavior is unchanged.
A genuine merge conflict on the same paths (both sides commit different content) still aborts without entering recovery, preserving today's behavior exactly.
